inputs: Qwen3.6 historical-ruler controller attempts and partial evidence

facts: The Dk64 speed-oracle performance gate failed on Qwen3.6-27B.
The PDC coexistence Hypic experiment completed and rejected adoption.
The no-cache versus Hypic-only historical reproduction is paused after baseline performance x3 and baseline LongBench-v2 run1.
Host NPU0-3 and CPU112-191 are the only authorized lane; NPU4-7 is forbidden.
The employee success was Qwen3.5-27B TP2 on two 910C cards, while the current paused case is Qwen3.6-27B TP4 on four 910B4 cards; topology is part of the experimental identity.
CEval is excluded and authoritative NIAH+ is absent.
No commit or push is authorized.

lessons.title: Name the exact denominator
lessons.trigger: A result is compared with prior work or an employee benchmark.
lessons.future_action: Encode model, TP degree, cache policy and the single changed switch in the experiment id and contract before launch.
lessons.verification: A reviewer can identify both arms and prove a one-switch difference without reading service logs.

lessons.title: Make pause a durable execution state
lessons.trigger: The operator pauses a long accelerator run.
lessons.future_action: Persist paused status, exact terminal operation, last complete unit, owned resource state and resume commands; never leave task or contract marked running.
lessons.verification: Static inspection identifies the next incomplete unit and cannot imply an active workload.

lessons.title: Validate serialized argv, not only shell syntax
lessons.trigger: A controller or command is generated through patches, templates or transport layers.
lessons.future_action: Run bash syntax, stray-argument scans and a no-side-effect self-test that renders the actual evaluator argv before workload mutation.
lessons.verification: The self-test rejects literal plus arguments and prints the expected option/value pairs.

lessons.title: Bind the verifier to the producer schema
lessons.trigger: A controller validates a JSON summary emitted by another tool.
lessons.future_action: Version the summary schema and run the verifier against a real fixture containing the producer's field names before launch.
lessons.verification: A valid summary using requests is accepted and a missing or renamed required field fails before NPU execution.

lessons.title: Persist model outputs before aggregate validation
lessons.trigger: A long concurrent evaluator may outlive its wrapper or verifier.
lessons.future_action: Write atomic per-sample JSONL checkpoints, hash the final details, and allow a corrected scorer or verifier to resume without regeneration.
lessons.verification: A controller failure after completion preserves unique complete rows and resume skips the validated artifact.

lessons.title: Keep profile capture and acceptance independent
lessons.trigger: The workload produces a usable native capture but an algorithm gate fails.
lessons.future_action: Record profiler exit, stimulus validity and algorithm acceptance separately; never reinterpret capture success as adoption.
lessons.verification: The decision remains rejected when semantic signals are missing even if profile payloads are valid.

lessons.title: Treat shared-host isolation as an executable contract
lessons.trigger: Multiple workloads share an eight-card host.
lessons.future_action: Pin exact host device nodes, CPU set, containers and port; inspect and clean only the owned lane.
lessons.verification: Every owned container maps only host NPU0-3/CPU112-191 and cleanup names one exact owned container.

lessons.title: Freeze card count and tensor parallelism
lessons.trigger: A prior successful practice used a different card count, accelerator generation or tensor-parallel degree.
lessons.future_action: Keep topology in the experiment identity and refuse to resume preserved evidence under a different TP degree; create a new feasibility case and baseline instead.
lessons.destination: task, experiment, decision, HANDOFF and knowledge proposal
lessons.verification: The current resume commands are explicitly TP4/NPU0-3, while any TP2 attempt is labeled a separate experiment and cannot reuse TP4 measurements.

commit_push.reason: Operator forbids fabricated Git identity and push; preserve the dirty branch for review.
